## Student Phone Usage Research

This data records students' daily phone usage, including the amount of time spent on their phones, whether they had a clear purpose, the main activity performed, and the time of day when usage was highest.The purpose of this analysis is to explore general trends in phone usage behaviour, such as how long students typically spend on their phones, what activities are most common, and when phone usage is most frequent during the day.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
logged_data <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vT7Y1LW_9CK6NEmm26ly59wqpmSB4hUfwNK4cra38ED7FFDhEfRhwRcooRHnZqLUbeogBpyoZp8rGGv/pub?output=csv")

rename_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(time_spent=2,
         purpose=3,
         activity=4,
         time_of_day=5)

#summary values
mean_time <- mean(rename_data$time_spent)
max_time <- max(rename_data$time_spent)

#bar_chart1
ggplot(rename_data)+
  geom_bar(aes(x = time_spent,fill=time_of_day)) +
  labs(title = "Time Spent Distribution")
#bar_chart2
ggplot(rename_data)+
  geom_bar(aes(x = time_spent,fill=activity)) +
labs(title = "Phone Usage Time by Activity Type")


```

The average daily screen time is `r round(mean_time, 1)` mins. The most commonly used phone time is evening. The maximum screen time recorded is `r max_time` mins.
